:::: {.hero}
# About

::: {.stand}
Notknowing Garden is a collaboration between two practitioners, FG and DS. We
lead retreats together that combine tantra and yoga, and we write about what
the research says about the body.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-about}
:::

## Who we are

::: {.ways}

::: {.way}
[FG]{.k}

Tantra practitioner and facilitator, trained in tantra therapy. Offers
one-to-one sessions and facilitates groups.

[about FG →](fg.qmd)
:::

## What we do

::: {.ways}

::: {.way}
[Retreats]{.k}

Three-day retreats in Germany, held in English, with accommodation and food
included. The first two are in 2027: one for practitioners who want to lead
groups, and one movement retreat for anyone.

[see the retreats →](../community/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[Writing]{.k}

Long reading guides to the research on touch, pain and breathing.

[read the writing →](../writing/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[A podcast]{.k}

Conversations with people who work with the body. No episodes yet.

[about the podcast →](../podcast/index.qmd)
:::

:::

## The name

Much of what is taught about the body is less certain than it sounds. We would
rather start from a question than from a fixed answer, in a room and on the
page. Notknowing Garden is a place to grow from there.
